name: School Friend Group Chat
description: Real-time web chat application for school friend groups with Express, Socket.IO channels, an expanded Campus Arcade featuring retro minigames (Snake, Space Defender, Flappy Campus, Brick Breaker) and featured web games (fps2.zeabur.app, fp.zeabur.app, highfly.zeabur.app), browser push notifications, campus moderation console, camera photo sharing, and customizable themes.
